waypoints.name: Whiskey Bend Trailhead
waypoints.note: Start of the Elwha River Trail; Olympic Hot Springs Road is washed out beyond Madison Falls, adding roughly 6.9 mi of walking or biking each way just to reach this trailhead.

waypoints.name: Hayes River Guard Station
waypoints.note: Historic Elwha River patrol cabin where the Hayes River joins the Elwha; reliable water and a junction with side trails into the upper valley.

waypoints.name: Chicago Camp / Elwha ford
waypoints.note: Established riverside camp; the Elwha River must be forded nearby to continue upvalley toward the basin, and can run cold and high with snowmelt.

waypoints.name: Elwha Basin
waypoints.note: Traditional high base camp used by Mountaineers club expeditions since the early 1900s; braided channels and brush ('the maze') make routefinding into the basin confusing.

waypoints.name: Elwha Snow Finger
waypoints.note: Steep, roughly 2-mile perennial snow/avalanche-debris gully gaining the Bailey Range crest from Elwha Basin; watch for hidden meltwater moats and rockfall off the flanking cliffs.

waypoints.name: Dodwell-Rixon Pass
waypoints.note: Gains the Elwha-Queets divide atop the Bailey Range; open scree and heather traversing toward the Noyes-Meany group begins here.

waypoints.name: Noyes-Meany Col
waypoints.note: Class 2+ saddle between Mount Noyes and Mount Meany; the standard scramble line onto Meany's upper slopes leaves the col here.

waypoints.name: North Fork Quinault Trailhead / Ranger Station
waypoints.note: End of North Fork Quinault River Road, south side of Olympic NP near Lake Quinault.
